kind: CodeClub public offline reading browser verification
scope: Real Chromium and production reading route using an original in-memory content fixture; no demo database mutation.
checks: Online reader saves only the whitelisted public API projection and renders text without executing markup.
CacheStorage contains no HTML, authentication payloads, private APIs or credentials.
Previously loaded public statement, examples and editorial remain readable with browser networking disabled.
Fresh HTML navigation requires the network.
Reconnect removes withdrawn material from both rendered content and the saved API cache.
Reconnected public content refreshes to the current published version.
Cross-tab account-switch cleanup removes reader content while retaining unrelated application storage.
Mobile public reading fits a 390px viewport.
